description: This file defines the FP_eventsController class, which extends SugarController to handle various actions related to event management within the SuiteCRM platform. The class includes methods for updating attendance and invitation statuses for event delegates, adding contacts/leads/prospects to events, and sending invitation emails with dynamic templates and attachments.

classes.name: FP_eventsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing event-related actions within SuiteCRM, including updating delegate statuses, handling contact and lead associations, and sending email invitations.

methods.name: action_markasinvited
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as 'Invited' for a given event, updating their invite_status in the respective relationship tables.

methods.name: action_markasattended
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as 'Attended' for a given event.

methods.name: action_markasnotattended
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as 'Not Attended'.

methods.name: action_markasnotinvited
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as 'Not Invited', resetting email response flags.

methods.name: action_markasaccepted
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as 'Accepted' in the invite process.

methods.name: action_markasdeclined
methods.description: Marks specified contacts, leads, and prospects as 'Declined' in the invite process.

methods.name: action_add_to_list
methods.description: Adds selected contacts, leads, or prospects to an event, establishing relationships via loaded Beans.

methods.name: action_sendinvitemails
methods.description: Sends invitation emails to related contacts, prospects, and leads who haven't responded yet, using templates and tracking success/failure.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Handles the process of sending emails via SugarPHPMailer, including adding attachments, setting headers, and logging sent emails in the system.
